title: Repeated missed deliveries and driver no-shows
situation: 6 customers are facing repeated courier no-shows and missed delivery appointments, including 2 VIPs.
hypothesis: Courier failed to deliver and missed scheduled dates.

params.reply_en: We missed your delivery and caused delays. We are investigating with the courier and will update you with a new delivery time tomorrow.
params.reply_ar: تأخرت عملية التوصيل ولم يتم الالتزام بالموعد المحدد. نتحقق حالياً مع شركة الشحن وسنوافيكم بموعد التوصيل الجديد غداً.

actions.why: Acknowledge the missed delivery and set expectations for an update.

params.note: Courier missed multiple delivery appointments for 6 customers.

actions.why: Escalate persistent courier no-shows to the logistics team for investigation.
Tag conversations for tracking courier performance issues.

reply_other.es: Lamentamos que no se haya realizado la entrega a tiempo. Estamos revisando el caso con la empresa de mensajería y te actualizaremos mañana.

alternatives.hypothesis: Items out of stock after failed delivery
alternatives.why: Customers asked about restocked items following missed deliveries.

alternatives.hypothesis: Customer support agents giving incorrect updates
alternatives.why: One customer complained about agents providing conflicting delivery dates.
